title: Media Overview
description: The whole media stack at a glance: storage, new items, downloads, playback, transcoding and health. Links at the top go to each app's own dashboard.

panels.title: /data01 used
panels.description: Share of the ZFS pool in use, as ocean's node-exporter sees it.

panels.title: Movies
panels.description: Movies with a file in Radarr.

panels.title: Episodes
panels.description: Episodes with a file in Sonarr.

panels.title: Transcoded, 24h
panels.description: tdarr transcodes that finished successfully in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Health issues
panels.description: Open health checks across the *arr apps. Details are in the Health row at the bottom.

panels.title: Space by collection
panels.description: Library sizes from the *arr apps; the last bar is the rest of /data01's used space.

panels.title: Plex libraries (items)
panels.description: Item count per Plex library. TV Shows counts episodes.

panels.title: Plex library change, 7d
panels.description: Items added (or removed, if negative) per Plex library over the last week.

panels.title: Net items added per day
panels.description: Rolling 24h difference in files on disk; dips are replacements or deletions.

panels.title: Open *arr health checks
panels.description: One row per open health check, from each app's exporter.
